articles.title: China steps up patrols near Taiwan
articles.summary: China launched a special maritime operation east of Taiwan, in direct response to a recent agreement between Japan and the Philippines. This pact involves negotiating maritime borders, an act Beijing views as challenging its regional claims. The operation underscores escalating tensions and China's assertive posture regarding its territorial waters amidst strengthening regional alliances.

articles.title: IAF being engaged to transport NEET question papers: NTA DG
articles.summary: The NTA Director General, Abhishek Singh, announced the Indian Air Force will transport NEET question papers for the national examination on June 21. This crucial inter-agency collaboration underscores the IAF's vital logistical support beyond combat roles, ensuring secure and efficient delivery of sensitive materials for a major national event. This highlights the diverse responsibilities of India's defence forces.

articles.title: Moment Kyiv launches devastating drone attack on St Petersburg as Zelensky warns Putin he will punish 'injustice against Ukraine'
articles.summary: Ukraine launched a significant long-range drone attack on Russia's St. Petersburg region, reportedly one of its boldest of the war. Dramatic footage showed thick smoke, indicating the strike's impact. This incident highlights Ukraine's expanding drone capabilities and strategic intent to target key Russian territories, underscoring the conflict's evolving geographical scope and modern warfare dynamics.

articles.title: Snipperclips Dev Is Bringing Its Murder Mystery Sequel To Switch 1 & 2 Next Month
articles.summary: SFB Games, known for titles like Snipperclips and Crow Country, recently unveiled 'The Mermaid's Mask' at the SGF Story Rich Showcase. This new murder mystery game is slated for release on both Nintendo Switch 1 and 2. The announcement highlights the studio's continued focus on narrative-driven experiences, expanding the popular console's diverse gaming library and demonstrating ongoing trends in digital entertainment technology.

articles.title: Former Padres Pitcher Dies at 75
articles.summary: Professional baseball pitcher Mike Johnson, known for his six-year career including a notable period with the San Diego Padres in 1974, has died at 75. While his big league career was brief, it left a lasting mark. Johnson's passing signifies the loss of a memorable figure from the sport's history, reminding us of athletes who shaped their eras.
